title: GitHub Integration

body.text: Codex is tightly tied to GitHub: it
opens a Pull Request automatically with a description of the changes
— the team reviews through GitHub as usual, using the workflow they already know.

example: "Task done → Codex opens a PR 'Add loading state to checkout button' with a description of what changed and why"

title: Codex in code review

body.text: Besides writing code, Codex can also
respond to PR comments and make fixes per the review
— when a reviewer comments asking for a change, you can have Codex make the fix without pulling the code to your machine.

example: "Reviewer: 'this should handle null too' → tell Codex: 'make the reviewer's requested change and push to the same PR'"

question: When a task finishes, what can Codex do on GitHub?

options.text: Open a Pull Request with a description

question: Does the team need to change its code-review workflow to use Codex?

options.text: No — review the PR on GitHub as usual
You must review only via email

question: A reviewer asks for a change on the PR Codex opened — what can you do?

options.text: Tell Codex to make the change per the comment and push to the same PR
You must always close the PR and start a new task
It can't be changed at all

question: What can Codex help with during code review?

options.text: Help review and propose improvements in the Pull Request

question: How should you use GitHub Integration well?

options.text: Let the AI help review, but a human still decides to merge
Let the AI merge by itself every time
